name: pi

backends.install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ripgrep fd-find ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && npm install --global --no-fund --no-audit --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.5.2

files.text: export default function (pi) { const base = process.env.VOICE_BASE_URL; if (!base) return; pi.registerProvider("voice", { name: "voice", baseUrl: base, api: "openai-completions", apiKey: "$VOICE_API_KEY", models: [{ id: "voice", name: "voice", reasoning: false, input: ["text"], cost: { input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0 }, contextWindow: 128000, maxTokens: 16384, compat: { supportsStore: false, supportsReasoningEffort: false, supportsDeveloperRole: true, supportsUsageInStreaming: true, maxTokensField: "max_completion_tokens" } }] }); }

login.setup: nothing on the node: voice mints the key for each attempt
login.describe: Voice's own key, not a vendor's login: voice mints one for each attempt as a node takes it, for the attempt's project and voice's inference alone, and revokes it when the attempt ends. Its requests are charged to the project that started the attempt, the attempt their conversation. The seat names no login; its model is the voice model pi calls.

preamble: You are working in a git repository checked out for you at /work, on a branch of its own. Leave your changes in the working tree: voice commits them when you finish. Do not push, and do not change the repository's remotes or git configuration. End your final message with one line that sums up what you changed: voice reads that last line as the change's title.
